d:
This project demonstrates how to build a fully functional AI chatbot using modern tools and frameworks. It combines LangChain's powerful prompt management with Streamlit's intuitive web interface and Groq's lightning-fast open-source models (Llama 3, Mixtral). The app features real-time streaming responses, conversation memory, and a clean user interface - all while being completely free to run using Groq's generous API tier.
Key Features:
Real-time chat interface with streaming responses
Ultra-fast inference using Groq's LPU technology
LangChain integration for prompt templates and chains
